items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I love reading about those guys. Like in Bill Crow’s book, you know. [INTERVIEWEE] He’s got great stories.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s just amazing. I remember you showed the film when you asked somebody what do they think about when they improvise – I think it was Bill Charlap. And you know, his answer was actually perfect. I mean I guess you really don’t sit down thinking all right I’m going to go from a C7 now to, I’ve got to make the third go here. Because how can you? You can’t. Well you’re an improviser. You know. It’s just so ingrained in you, it’s like breathing I guess. And I guess that was Prez man. Beautiful music just came…
I love reading about those guys. Like in Bill Crow’s book, you know.
